entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: A proud and arrogant Aven leader of the Order on Otaria who used the Mirari and died when his own crystals drained his essence.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: The Otarian order of knights whose citadel Kirtar helped lead.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A mysterious orb of great power that corrupted Kirtar.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A faction that runs pit fights and holds treasure troves in Cabal City.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The city hosting the Cabal's largest tournament and attacked by a Krosan dragon.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian pit fighter who burned back the dragon's growth and killed it.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A pit fighter in the tournament.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A pit fighter in the tournament.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: A pit fighter who stole the Mirari from Kirtar.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A Mer ambassador who implanted false memories of friendship in Kirtar and sought the Mirari.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: Commander of the Northern Order whom Kirtar engulfed in crystals.

entities.name: Krosan dragon
entities.description: A dragon that attacked Cabal City and was killed by Kamahl.

entities.name: Aven
entities.description: The pale-skinned bird-like race Kirtar belongs to.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: The forest whose creatures Kirtar attacked.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The conflict over the Mirari on Otaria.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land of Dominaria where the Order operates.

events.summary: Kirtar competes in the Cabal's largest pit-fight tournament in Cabal City, hoping to win an artifact for the Order to destroy.
events.quote: Hoping to claim a powerful artifact for the Order to destroy

events.summary: A Krosan dragon attacks the city, Kirtar leads the defense, and Kamahl kills the dragon, leaving Kirtar to receive the reward.
Kirtar receives the Mirari and is overcome by the power it offers him.
events.quote: Kirtar was overcome by the power the device offered him

events.summary: Kirtar and his men repel beast attacks on the northern plains, then attack the forest of Krosa itself.
events.quote: Kirtar decides to take the initiative and attack the forest itself to slaughter any dangerous animals.

events.summary: Laquatus, who had implanted false memories of friendship, joins Kirtar, and Pianna orders Kirtar and his men to withdraw.
events.quote: She ordered Kirtar and his men to withdraw back to the Order's citadel.

events.summary: Kirtar organizes a coup, demands command of the Order and uses the Mirari to engulf Pianna in crystals.
events.quote: Kirtar used the Mirari on Pianna, creating a wave of crystals that engulfed her.

events.summary: The spell spreads out of control; Turg steals the Mirari and Kirtar fades to nothing as the spell drains his essence.
events.quote: Kirtar faded away to nothing as the spell drained away his very essence to feed itself.

relations.note: An Aven leader of the Order.
relations.quote: Lieutenant Kirtar was an Aven leader of the Order on Otaria

relations.note: Relations worsened and he used the Mirari on her.
relations.quote: relations between Kirtar and Pianna got steadily worse.

relations.note: Implanted false memories of friendship in Kirtar to steal the Mirari.
relations.quote: had implanted false memories of friendship in the Aven's mind

relations.note: Killed the dragon attacking Cabal City.
